names.note: The nominative behind the «Николая» of days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 7 марта ст. ст., name page 9730, «Николай (Розов), иерей, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off; the day's own line declines the forename and gives no surname at all. azbyka.ru writes the surname without brackets, «Священномученик Николай Розов, пресвитер», and it is a family surname and not a monastic name: his father was the priest Николай Розов. The brackets are the calendar's own and are kept, which is the shape every other Russian new martyr in this corpus carries.

birth.note: azbyka.ru: «Священномученик Николай родился в 1870 году в селе Иваньково Ростовского уезда Ярославской губернии в семье священника Николая Розова».

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 7 марта ст. ст. with «(1930)», and azbyka.ru gives the day: «Священник Николай Розов скончался 20 марта 1930 года в ярославской тюрьме и был погребен в безвестной могиле». The civil 20 March 1930 is that Julian 7 March, so the day of his death and his feast are the same day. No day is recorded here because this corpus records years.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1930).»

attestations.note: The day page carries no life for him and his name page 9730 carries none either; the life in this folder is azbyka.ru's. Name page 9730 lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church, and azbyka.ru lists two further synaxes besides. One row per church being the schema, the second days are recorded here and in the life and he renders on none of them. **The calendar keeps a second Николай (Розов)**, an archpriest and confessor who died in 1941 and whom it keeps on 25 сентября ст. ст. with the name page this corpus cites on `nicholas-rozov`; the two are eleven years and six months apart and nothing read links them.
